transport: BLE advertisement, no connection and no pairing session needed to read — but pairing once is needed to obtain the key. Victron manufacturer data, byte 3 = 0x10 Product Advertisement; the extra-manufacturer-data record starts at byte 8. Header: bits 0–7 record type (0x08 here), 8–23 nonce LSB-first, 24–31 byte 0 of the encryption key. Payload AES-CTR, 2-byte header nonce, MSB counter from 0. Max re
blocks: Record 0x08, offsets from the start of the record: 32/8 device state (NA 0xFF, VE_REG_DEVICE_STATE) · 40/8 charger error (NA 0xFF, VE_REG_CHR_ERROR_CODE) · 48/13 battery voltage 1, 0.01 V, 0–81.90 V (NA 0x1FFF) · 61/11 battery current 1, 0.1 A, 0–204.6 A (NA 0x7FF) · 72/13 battery voltage 2 · 85/11 battery current 2 · 96/13 battery voltage 3 · 109/11 battery current 3 · 120/7 temperature °C, −40..86, value = record − 40 (NA 0x7F) · 127/9 AC current 0.1 A, 0–51.0 A (NA 0x1FF, VE_REG_AC_ACTIVE_INPUT_L1_CURRENT) · 136/24 unused.
